name: Curse of Death
body:
The reaper’s grasp is cold and inevitable.

Bonus Spells: 0th—touch of fatigue, 1st—false life, 2nd—hideous laughter, 3rd—fear, 4th—slay living

Curse Manifestation

The lathspell constantly seems to be weak and sick at first glance, regardless of their true vitality, as a result of their curse. This is accompanied by an aura with a range of 10 feet that saps the life from living creatures whenever they experience a deadly blow. Whenever a critical threat is rolled against a creature in this aura the confirmation roll gains a +2 bonus.

Curse Abilities
Antipathic Spirit (Ex)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

The curse of death leaves the lathspell with a body more like those of the undead. You are harmed by positive energy and healed by negative energy as though you were undead, though your type does not change. At 7th level, you receive channel resistance +2. This bonus increases by +2 at 11th level and 15th level.

Ashes to Ashes (Su)

The curse of death grants the lathspell mastery over necromantic energies. As a standard action you may touch a living creature and deal 1d6 negative energy damage per two class levels to the target unless they succeed at a Will saving throw. A successful saving throw reduces the damage by half. Alternatively you can target an undead creature (or other target normally healed by negative energy) and restore hit points to the target instead. If you have the antipathic spirit curse ability, you can heal yourself with this touch.

Deadman’s Focus (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

The lathspell sometimes unnerves their allies due to their unnatural resistance to the world’s terrors.

Whenever you would make a saving throw against a fear effect, you roll twice and take the better result. At 12th level you instead gain immunity to fear. When you succeed on a Will save against fear, or ignore a fear effect, you gain +4 to Intimidate checks for 1 minute against those who witness your unmoved countenance.

Death’s Visage (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 10th level or higher

Lathspells carrying the curse of death sometimes manifest the ability to become as a specter, a ghostly entity able to reach anyone without warning. You can become invisible and incorporeal for a number of minutes per day equal to your Charisma modifier. Activating this ability is a swift action and it must be used in one minute increments. Ending the ability is a free action. At 15th level you may use the ability a number of minutes per day equal to ten times your Charisma modifier. At 20th level this ability may be used at will.

Dust to Dust (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 10th level or higher

The curse of death prevents those slain by the lathspell from being returned to life. Whenever you kill a creature with an attack, ability or spell that deals hit point damage that creature is much harder to raise from the dead. In order to do so, the user of any raise or resurrection magic upon the corpse must succeed at a caster level check against a DC 15 + your class level. Failure means that the the attempt to return the target to life fails and the corpse has been irreparably damaged and can only be restored to life via true resurrection, miracle, or wish. In addition to the above, the corpse becomes much easier to raise as an undead creature, forgoing the material component to do so for spells such as animate dead.

Ebon Cloak (Su)

The curse of death provides protection for the lathspell and inflicts pain upon those who damage them. You can summon a set of armor made from bones and shadow as a move action. The ebon cloak is considered light armor, has no weight, armor check penalty, or maximum dexterity bonus, and provides a +4 armor bonus.

In addition, whenever you take damage from a melee attack, the attacker takes 1d4 damage.

At 8th level and every four levels thereafter the armor bonus of the ebon cloak increases by +2 and the damage dealt to attackers increases by 1d4. This ability may be used for a number of hours per day equal to your class level. These hours need not be consecutive but must be used in one hour increments.

Hand of the Grave (Su)

Those around the lathspell always feel a sort of unease, as though their lives are always in danger. As a standard action you may choose a creature within 30 ft. that you can see. The targeted creature must make a Fortitude save or become stricken with the fear of mortality. For 24 hours after failing the saving throw the target gains a -2 penalty to all attack rolls, skill checks, saving throws, and ability checks as long as they are within one mile of the lathspell; if the target succeeds they are shaken until the start of your next turn. This ability cannot increase the level of fear of the target beyond being shaken and once a creature has been targeted, it cannot be targeted again until 24 hours have passed.

On Ghastly Wings (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

Sometimes death takes flight in order to chase down those about to meet their fate. As a swift action, you can manifest a set of dark, shadowy wings that grant a fly speed of 30 feet with average maneuverability. At 10th level this fly speed improves to 60ft and the maneuverability improves to good. At 15th level level the maneuverability becomes perfect. These wings may be used for a number of hours per day equal to your class level.

These hours need not be consecutive but must be used in one hour increments.

Pale Horse (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level): The curse of death calls the trappings of a reaper to the lathspell including a worthy steed. When you select this curse ability you gain the service of a special animal companion, using your lathspell level as your druid level to determine its abilities. This animal uses all the statics of the horse animal companion except as follows. The horse is bone white and its eyes are red; it is clearly not a normal animal and other animals are wary of it though they do not lash out or flee from it. The pale horse is unaffected by natural difficult terrain, though manipulated terrain and terrain created by spells or special abilities still affect the pale horse as normal. At 9th level the pale horse may water walk at will and at 12th level it gains a fly speed equal to its base land speed at good maneuverability.

Voice of the Dead (Su)

Death’s curse grants the lathspell the ability to entreat the dead. You can speak with any undead creature, even those without an Intelligence score and can even use Diplomacy to affect these creatures’ attitudes. In addition, you gain a +4 bonus on all Diplomacy and Intimidate checks when dealing with undead and those who serve gods whose portfolio includes death. At 5th level you may cast speak with dead at will, though a given corpse can only be affected once every 24 hours, using your class level as your caster level.

Walking Curse
Aspect of the Reaper (Su)

The lathspell gains immunity to negative energy and death effects (unless they wish to be affected by them) as well as the ability to proclaim the death of a creature once per day. To do so, they choose one creature they can see within 60 feet and declare its death as a full round action. The target then makes a Fortitude save with a DC of 20 + the lathspell’s Charisma modifier or dies instantly. A creature slain by this ability cannot be raised or resurrected by any magic short of a miracle or wish spell.
